briefdescription.para: getSOImmValImm - Given an encoded imm field for the reg/imm form, return the 8-bit imm value.
getSOImmValRot - Given an encoded imm field for the reg/imm form, return the rotate amount.
getSOImmValRotate - Try to handle Imm with an immediate shifter operand, computing the rotate amount to use.

detaileddescription.para: If this immediate value cannot be handled with a single shifter-op, determine a good rotate amount that will take a maximal chunk of bits out of the immediate.

briefdescription.para: getSOImmVal - Given a 32-bit immediate, if it is something that can fit into an shifter_operand immediate operand, return the 12-bit encoding for it.
isSOImmTwoPartVal - Return true if the specified value can be obtained by or'ing together two SOImmVal's.
getSOImmTwoPartFirst - If V is a value that satisfies isSOImmTwoPartVal, return the first chunk of it.
getSOImmTwoPartSecond - If V is a value that satisfies isSOImmTwoPartVal, return the second chunk of it.
isSOImmTwoPartValNeg - Return true if the specified value can be obtained by two SOImmVal, that -V = First + Second.

detaileddescription.para: "R+V" can be optimized to (sub (sub R, First), Second). "R=V" can be optimized to (sub (mvn R, ~(-First)), Second).

briefdescription.para: getThumbImmValShift - Try to handle Imm with a 8-bit immediate followed by a left shift.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the shift amount to use.

briefdescription.para: isThumbImmShiftedVal - Return true if the specified value can be obtained by left shifting a 8-bit immediate.
getThumbImm16ValShift - Try to handle Imm with a 16-bit immediate followed by a left shift.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the shift amount to use.

briefdescription.para: isThumbImm16ShiftedVal - Return true if the specified value can be obtained by left shifting a 16-bit immediate.
getThumbImmNonShiftedVal - If V is a value that satisfies isThumbImmShiftedVal, return the non-shiftd value.
getT2SOImmValSplat - Return the 12-bit encoded representation if the specified value can be obtained by splatting the low 8 bits into every other byte or every byte of a 32-bit value.

detaileddescription.para: i.e., 00000000 00000000 00000000 abcdefgh control = 0 00000000 abcdefgh 00000000 abcdefgh control = 1 abcdefgh 00000000 abcdefgh 00000000 control = 2 abcdefgh abcdefgh abcdefgh abcdefgh control = 3 Return -1 if none of the above apply. See ARM Reference Manual A6.3.2.

briefdescription.para: getT2SOImmValRotateVal - Return the 12-bit encoded representation if the specified value is a rotated 8-bit value.

detaileddescription.para: Return -1 if no rotation encoding is possible. See ARM Reference Manual A6.3.2.

briefdescription.para: getT2SOImmVal - Given a 32-bit immediate, if it is something that can fit into a Thumb-2 shifter_operand immediate operand, return the 12-bit encoding for it.

detaileddescription.para: If not, return -1. See ARM Reference Manual A6.3.2.
